slides.needs: two boxers sparring in dim gym, wide shot
slides.text: Here's exactly why you keep getting hit in sparring...
Your head stays in the middle after you punch. Move it every time you throw.

slides.needs: boxer in guard, side profile silhouette
slides.text: Your hands drop when you get tired. Gloves back to your cheekbones after every punch.
You back up in a straight line. Step off to the side instead.

slides.needs: boxer staring across the ring, faceless/backlit
slides.text: You watch the gloves. Watch his chest, it moves first.
